character_description: Young adult male in his mid-20s, bright and agile voice, quick-witted and smooth tone, fast but clear pacing, opportunistic and charming quality, street-smart businessman with natural charisma. Studio-quality recording.
audition_line: 消息就是金钱，这话一点不假。我在这圈子里认识的人多，各种小道消息都能第一时间打听到。别人还在猜的时候，我已经心里有数了。做买卖嘛，信息差就是利润！
